description.zh:
备份涉及到的数据库，多个数据库间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
> 仅当备份级别为数据库级时该参数才生效。
description.en:
The databases to back up. Separate multiple databases with commas (,).
> This parameter takes effect only when the backup level is set to database level.

description.zh:
备份级别，取值范围如下：
* db：数据库级
* instance：实例级
description.en:
The backup level. Valid values:
* db: database level
* instance: instance level

description.zh:
备份日志是否开启，取值范围如下：
* 1：开启
* 0：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable backup logging. Valid values:
* 1: enabled
* 0: disabled

description.zh:
备份模式，取值范围如下：
* **logic**：逻辑备份
* **phy**：物理备份
description.en:
The backup mode. Valid values:
* **logic**: logical backup
* **phy**: physical backup

description.zh: 数据备份保留天数，取值范围为7~730天。
description.en: The number of days for which data backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 730.

description.zh: 日志保留天数，取值范围为7~730天，且必须小于或等于数据备份天数。
description.en: The number of days for which log backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 730. The value must be less than or equal to the data backup retention period.
The end time of the backup.

description.zh:
备份周期，取值范围如下：
* 0：周一
* 1：周二
* 2：周三
* 3：周四
* 4：周五
* 5：周六
* 6：周日
description.en:
The backup cycle. Valid values:
* 0: Monday
* 1: Tuesday
* 2: Wednesday
* 3: Thursday
* 4: Friday
* 5: Saturday
* 6: Sunday
The start time of the backup.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds set-backup-policy --drds-instance-id drds000000000000 --preferred-backup-period 0 --preferred-backup-start-time 11:30:30 --preferred-backup-end-time 12:30:30 --backup-mode phy --backup-level db --backup-db-names test1,test2 --backup-log 1 --data-backup-retention-period 7 --log-backup-retention-period 7 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
